snippet.title: Mado Marks Trailer - VAINSANE Fridays #7
snippet.description:
VAINSANE Fridays #7 — Mado Marks 

Three students record themselves in a classroom room that shouldn’t exist... The next morning, one of them is gone forever... A short psychological horror VN about memory, proof, and erasure.

Part of VAINSANE Fridays, where I release a new bite-sized horror game every other Friday. Released August, 2026.

Buy on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4832290/Mado_Marks/
